title: South Karelia: 2.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €117,250 a year
markdown:
# South Karelia: 2.1 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €117,250 a year

> Closes 2.1 of 5.8 missing patients a year (36%) · €117,250 of €1.00M · €882,750 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in South Karelia, 19 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 6 patients a year. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 8.1 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure (range 5.0–11.0) [^care_curative] [^model]. Compared with Finland as a whole, the model puts 0.0 of the missing patients a year in surgery and 5.8 in radiotherapy that aims to cure [^model]. Part of the gap may be treatment that was given but not recorded: 42.8% have no treatment on record [^care_no_record] [^model].

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 18.9% to 21.9% by 2028: 2.1 more patients a year (range 0.0–3.4), for €117,250 a year, about €55,307 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 36% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (5.8 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **Step zero: fix the records (no direct effect)** | | | | |
| 0 | **Check the charts of patients with no treatment on record**[^ev_recording_audit_1]. Chief physician of oncology and the head of clinical coding | €8,000 | 0.0 | Pull 50 patients diagnosed in 2023 with no treatment on record and check their charts this month. | Share of patients with no treatment on record: 42.8% → 27.5% by 2027 |
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Travel and hotel paid for patients far from the university hospital**[^ev_travel_accommodation_support_1]. Chief physician of oncology and hospital social work; university hospital patient hotel | €22,300 | 0.6 (0.0–1.0) | Name one contact person who books the patient hotel and transport for every patient sent to the university hospital for curative treatment. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 18.9% → 19.8% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Precise radiotherapy (SBRT) for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €16,200 | 0.6 (0.0–1.1) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 18.9% → 19.7% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Fitness test and training before anyone is ruled too frail for curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €19,750 | 0.2 (0.0–0.2) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 18.9% → 19.2% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 4 | **Weekly video review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital's specialists**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 0.7 (0.0–1.0) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 18.9% → 20.0% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€117,250** | **2.1 (0.0–3.4)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €392,714 a year; modelled to avoid 0.7 deaths a year (0.1–1.7). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 18.9% (2019–2023, measured) → 21.9% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients with no treatment on record: 42.8% → 27.5% by 2027. [^care_no_record][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €882,750 buys nothing more: the access measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money [^model]. Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers is the other route, but it needs a national decision [^model]. Ranking measures by deaths avoided instead would put the money into pathway measures [^model]. Lung cancer causes about 58 deaths a year in South Karelia, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.3 of them (range 0.0–1.0) [^deaths] [^model].

## Limits

- Effect sizes are assumptions, not trial results. Each range runs from all assumptions at their lowest to all at their highest. It is not a probability range [^model].
- The comparison with the expected share is adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, histology, how the cancer was found or smoking. County figures cannot show cause [^model].
- 42.8% have no treatment on record, against 27.5% in Finland. Audit the records before reading the gap as missing care [^care_no_record] [^model].

flagged.sentence: Compared with Finland as a whole, 0.0 fewer a year are operated and 5.8 fewer are given radiotherapy that aims to cure [^model].
flagged.reason: The split between surgery and radiotherapy is the model's arithmetic on the measured shortfall, not a measured count of radiotherapy; rewritten to say the model assigns the missing patients this way.

flagged.sentence: Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, fitness, histology, how the cancer was found or smoking. County figures cannot show cause [^model].
flagged.reason: The reported shares are not adjusted; only the expected-share comparison is adjusted for the share of residents aged 65 or over. Rewritten so the reader does not take 19 vs 27 as age-adjusted.

ev_ldct_screening_1.design: randomised trial (UKLS) + random-effects meta-analysis of 9 trials
